# langsmith_project_agent_versions (Data Source)

Lists **agent deployment versions** recorded for a LangSmith project (tracer session) using the platform API (`GET /v1/platform/sessions/{sessionID}/agent-versions`). Use the project UUID from `langsmith_project` as `session_id` for auditing or pinning agent revisions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_project_agent_versions" "example" {
  session_id = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `session_id` (String) The project (tracer session) UUID — the same value as `langsmith_project.id` and other `session_id` arguments in this provider.

### Read-Only

- `agent_versions` (Attributes List) Versions observed for this session (`tracer_sessions.AgentVersionResponse` items from the API). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_versions))
- `id` (String) The stable identifier for this data source, set to `session_id`.

<a id="nestedatt--agent_versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agent_versions`

Read-Only:

- `commit_sha` (String) Commit SHA associated with a deployed agent revision.
- `first_seen_at` (String) RFC3339-style timestamp from the API for when this revision was first seen.
